F7-RR-05.defect: Bound-measure validation was skipped on the positive path. measure_authority_refs are AuthorityRef objects, but quantity_surface.measure_ref was parsed with _require_ref, which accepts only ExactRef; the resulting exception was caught and converted to measure_ref=None, so the bound-measure comparison never ran and the emitted receipt serialized measure_ref as null.
F7-RR-05.impact: A directional delta could be minted with no exact bound measure on the quantity surface.
F7-RR-05.court_gap_named_by_the_review: The mismatch witness supplied a different ExactRef while the positive fixture supplied an AuthorityRef, so no witness proved the valid-path binding.

repair.measure_ref_required: An absent measure_ref now refuses; a directional delta may never be minted without one.
repair.both_exact_forms_accepted: An AuthorityRef and an ExactRef are both accepted, each reduced to its exact identity and key.
repair.comparison_enforced: The identity is compared against the positively resolved bound measures on EVERY path, and a mismatch refuses.
repair.serialization_fixed: The exact identity is serialized into the receipt instead of null.

after.serialized_measure_ref: authority_id MEAS1 with its content hash

F7-RR-05.no_tolerance_introduced: The repair compares exact identities only. No tolerance, deadband or epsilon was added; see 04 for the AST-level verification.

F7-RR-06.defect: A missing required temporal_order_basis_ref was not detected during derivation. It surfaced later as a cross-field TemporalComparabilityIntegrityError, so the accepted disposition TEMPORAL_INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY / TEMPORAL_ORDER_BASIS_AUTHORITY_REF_ABSENT could never be emitted.

reproduced_before.message: an authorized order basis requires an exact basis ref

F7-RR-06.repair: An authorized order disposition with no basis ref now appends the ACCEPTED reason TEMPORAL_ORDER_BASIS_AUTHORITY_REF_ABSENT during derivation, and the cross-field validator accepts a null basis ref only when the receipt reports exactly that accepted refusal state and reason.
F7-RR-06.reason_code_discipline: TEMPORAL_ORDER_BASIS_AUTHORITY_REF_ABSENT was already a member of the accepted precedence list for TEMPORAL_INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY. No new reason code was invented.
F7-RR-06.fail_closed_retained: A null basis ref paired with any other state or reason still raises, so the relaxation is narrow and cannot mask a different defect.
F7-RR-06.court_updated: test_authorized_basis_requires_a_basis_ref previously asserted the IntegrityError, which WAS the defect. It now asserts the accepted terminal, and additionally asserts DIRECTION_NOT_CLAIMABLE with no delta.

F7-RR-07.defect: A partial-order request could convert a higher-priority terminal failure into an exception. PARTIAL_ORDER_NO_DIRECTION plus an unresolved identity first selected TEMPORAL_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED and then raised, because the code required the state to be one of the two comparable-no-direction states.
F7-RR-07.repair: The partial-order guard now applies only when the selected state is itself COMPARABLE. When a higher-priority terminal was detected, precedence governs and that state is emitted. The guard remains for the comparable branch, so a comparable state that is neither partial-order state still raises.
F7-RR-07.why_this_is_correct_not_merely_quiet: The advertised relation-state precedence is total. A request may legitimately combine a partial-order disposition with an independent higher-priority failure; the failure is the truthful outcome. Emitting TEMPORAL_INTERVAL_OVERLAP_NO_DIRECTION there would have claimed comparability that the identity failure contradicts.

secondary_target_use_permission_refs.defect: target_use_permission_refs consumed only element zero. Additional supplied permission refs were never validated or recorded, so a receipt could claim a governed use that one bound permission did not cover.
secondary_target_use_permission_refs.repair: Every supplied permission ref is resolved. Each contributes its own resolution record, slotted target_use_permission for the first and target_use_permission[i] thereafter, preserving the historical slot name in the common single-ref case. An empty tuple yields TARGET_USE_PERMISSION_REF_ABSENT.
secondary_target_use_permission_refs.contract_conformance: The accepted contract types this slot as tuple[ExactRef, ...] and required, so resolving all supplied refs follows the contract rather than inventing a cardinality-one rule.

ordering_guarantees_preserved.coherence_gate_placement: The registry-level and material-binding gates run before any positive receipt is assembled.
ordering_guarantees_preserved.measure_gate_placement: The measure identity is resolved and compared before derived_delta is computed.
